Subject: Sponsor intro + request for VP/CTO presence

Hi Ben —

Thanks for the productive discovery call today. We'd like to move to a short "sponsor" briefing/demo next week to show the exec roadmap and discuss our integration priorities. For this conversation it's important that a VP or CTO-level sponsor from Redwood attend to speak to architecture, deployment options, and SLAs.

Can your team join for a 45-minute session? Our preferred windows are:
- Tue Jul 13, 10:00–10:45 PT (US morning)
- Wed Jul 14, 20:00–20:45 PT (to include APAC stakeholders)

If VP/CTO availability is tight, an AVP/Head of Platform who can answer architecture and capacity questions would also work — we'd just like clear sponsor-level alignment.

I've attached a brief product roadmap and a one-page agenda.

Best,
Elaine Park
Director of Partnerships | Greenline Systems
